title: Foundry boss pack (slice 1: crypt-crawler, generic is_boss envelope)
description: Canonical format for a generated boss. Slice 1 targets the crypt-crawler generic is_boss phase envelope (engine.js: 50% summon skeletons + log tell, 25% enrage x1.3 + log tell), so phases are fixed to that envelope and custom specials are out of scope until the slice-2 interpreter ADR.

pack_version.description: Major 1 only. The consumer loader accepts pack_version 1.x and rejects anything else with the field and the reason.

target_game.description: Slice 1 ships one consumer. Other games get their own const + adapter later.

boss_id.description: Registry key. boss_ prefix keeps data bosses in the BOSS_TEMPLATES namespace.

stats.description: Bands keep max theoretical single-turn damage (phase-3 attack vs 0 defense, max variance 1.2, omen x1.0) at or under ONE_HIT_CAP=53: paladin base 65 HP +12/level, depth-3 expected level >= 3 gives >= 89 HP, 60% of that is ~53.

phases.description: Slice-1 envelope only: exactly the two transitions the engine implements for any is_boss.

item_id.description: Must resolve in the consumer ITEM_CATALOG at load time.

spawn.description: Slice 1: depth-3 stairs replacement of boss_lich for the listed seeds. This preserves the consumer invariants (exactly 1 boss, on the stairs) that test_depth_three_boss_guards_the_stairs and validate_fairness.py enforce.
